name: 引爆全场
effectDescription: 后台时活跃角色ATK+10%+2%/层(最多4层)，每2秒触发1次，站场时重置。站场时灵魂伤害+12%+2%/层(最多10层)，每0.3秒触发1次，切换角色时重置。

effectDescriptionEn: While off-field, increases active character ATK by 10% + 2%/stack (max 4), triggering every 2s. Resets when on-field. While on-field, increases Psyche DMG by 12% + 2%/stack (max 10), triggering every 0.3s. Resets when switching.
howToObtainZh: 完成绘空町异象委托「律动大师」，击败Boss
howToObtainEn: Complete Heterocity Anomaly Commission Rhythm Master, defeat boss

name: 茶花会
effectDescription: HP不因受伤减少时暴伤+12%~20%持续5秒，最多4层。解锁弧盘·静默庭院：消耗5%当前HP，随机发动苛责(5次咒术伤害24%~40%ATK)或絮叨(6次咒术伤害18%~30%ATK，末次双倍)(CD 25秒)。
effectDescriptionTw: HP不因受傷減少時暴傷+12%~20%持續5秒，最多4層。解鎖弧盤·靜默庭院：消耗5%當前HP，隨機發動苛責(5次咒術傷害24%~40%ATK)或絮叨(6次咒術傷害18%~30%ATK，末次雙倍)(CD 25秒)。
effectDescriptionEn: Increases CRIT DMG by 12-20% for 5s when HP is reduced without taking damage, up to 4 stacks. Unlocks Arc: Silent Garden - consumes 5% HP, randomly performs Harsh Rebuke (5x Incantation DMG 24-40% ATK) or Incessant Nagging (6x 18-30% ATK, final hit 2x) (CD 25s).
howToObtainZh: 击败世界Boss塞润尼缇；完成番外「不言不知秋」
howToObtainEn: Defeat World Boss Sereniti; complete Extra Chapter

effectDescriptionTw: 每持有10萬源泉，宇宙傷害+2.5%~4.5%，最多10層。
effectDescriptionEn: Increases Cosmos DMG by 2.5-4.5% for every 100,000 Fons held, up to 10 stacks.
